**Onsite (main leak)**
- 10 candidates reached Onsite. 1 advanced to Offer, 1 was rejected, 5 withdrew, and 3 are still active.
- The 5 withdrawals all cite accepting another offer. They left a median of 15.1 days into the stage, and the median time after their last interview was 13.3 days. This suggests the decision lag between the onsite and the offer is losing people to faster competitors. Check how long feedback and offer approval take after Onsite.
- Compared with your other roles in scope (JOB-5 and JOB-7), Onsite pass rate here is 14.3% against 50.0%.

**Data notes**
- The "conversion_pct" in the pipeline view is reached-over-prior-stage (for example, Onsite 66.7%). The pass rates above are advanced divided by exits (for example, Onsite 1 of 7 = 14.3%). They measure different things, so the numbers differ.
